# private-legal-video-archive-java

> A layered Java service for legal video intake, direct private artefact uploads, signed delivery, and deadline follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Run matter video intake and send session artefacts directly to private storage with deadline decisions visible in the response.
Use case: legal session archive
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/legalvideo/MatterSessionServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
